svg.title: Allocate Startup Cash Before Buying Payment Spread
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-07-startup-capital-four-bucket-allocation; chart type: stacked_comparison; title: Allocate Startup Cash Before Buying Payment Spread; subtitle: Four buckets reconcile to lean $12,000, planning $35,000, and expanded $65,000.; chapter number: 4; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: Numeric values show the $35,000 planning stack in USD. Every detail supplies corresponding lean and expanded allocations. These are setup-and-liquidity budgets, not property purchase prices, annual expenses, or a promise that acceleration can be funded from startup cash.; caption: Lean total: $3,000 + $4,000 + $2,000 + $3,000 = $12,000. Planning total: $8,000 + $10,000 + $7,000 + $10,000 = $35,000. Expanded total: $15,000 + $20,000 + $10,000 + $20,000 = $65,000.; stages: label: Professional structure and document setup; value: $8,000 planning allocation establishes transaction-specific operating documents; numeric value: 8000.0; detail: Lean $3,000; planning $8,000; expanded $15,000. Fund counsel review, RMLO engagement setup, entity records, state requirement mapping, and initial title diligence. Per-closing costs still require separate transaction budgets.; label: Transaction and reinstatement liquidity; value: $10,000 planning allocation supports documented closing cash requirements; numeric value: 10000.0; detail: Lean $4,000; planning $10,000; expanded $20,000. Hold cash for verified arrears, title cures, and closing timing differences. Decline deals whose cure requirements exceed committed funds; these amounts cannot fund an arbitrary senior-mortgage payoff.; label: Sourcing and servicing infrastructure; value: $7,000 planning allocation builds auditable records and payment rails; numeric value: 7000.0; detail: Lean $2,000; planning $7,000; expanded $10,000. Configure a CRM such as HubSpot, access-controlled document storage, licensed-servicer boarding, bookkeeping, and payment reconciliation exports. Use dual review for payment destination changes.; label: Runway and exception cash reserve; value: $10,000 planning allocation protects early operating continuity; numeric value: 10000.0; detail: Lean $3,000; planning $10,000; expanded $20,000. Preserve cash for operating delays and payment exceptions. At $2,000–$12,000 monthly opex, $10,000 covers roughly 0.83–5 months before transaction shocks; arrange more runway when the 2–6 month first-deal window requires it.

rect.title: label: Professional structure and document setup; numeric value: 8000.0; value: $8,000 planning allocation establishes transaction-specific operating documents; detail: Lean $3,000; planning $8,000; expanded $15,000. Fund counsel review, RMLO engagement setup, entity records, state requirement mapping, and initial title diligence. Per-closing costs still require separate transaction budgets.

rect.title: label: Transaction and reinstatement liquidity; numeric value: 10000.0; value: $10,000 planning allocation supports documented closing cash requirements; detail: Lean $4,000; planning $10,000; expanded $20,000. Hold cash for verified arrears, title cures, and closing timing differences. Decline deals whose cure requirements exceed committed funds; these amounts cannot fund an arbitrary senior-mortgage payoff.
